responsibility: Defines the 32-bit PA register file model used by register allocation, calling conventions, debugging, and constraint handling. It specifies hard-register numbering, fixed and call-used sets, allocation order, mode-to-register suitability and width rules, debugger register mappings, register classes and their contents, argument-passing register tests, and assembler register names for the PA32 view that includes split-addressable floating-point halves.
